notes: PCB layers/sizes/placements are engineering judgement unless 'basis' is a URL; only the ECM/DCU placement count (~412 components, Bosch DCU17HD01 teardown) is sourced.

Sources were read from web-search result snippets; vendor sites could not be fetched (egress blocked) and the search budget ran out before cluster/IVI, NOx/DCU, glow-plug and fuel-pump sources were found - those ICs are engineering judgement.
MHEV/HEV/PHEV semiconductor content is interpolated; Infineon (Dec 2024) publishes ICE ~USD 750 and BEV ~USD 1,300 only.

ecus.name: Body control module
ecus.function: Exterior/interior lighting, locks, wipers, window/mirror loads, switch inputs; LIN master for body nodes.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg, 2 oz outer copper for load paths; through-hole + SMT connectors

keyIcs.role: high-side / low-side relay, motor and load drivers
examples: TI high-/low-side driver portfolio in TIDA-00296 (loads: door locks, window lifts, seat heaters, HVAC, lamps, LEDs)
TI BCM solution: LDOs, CAN, LIN, limp-home, high-side switches

ecus.name: Central gateway / vehicle network processor
ecus.function: Routes and firewalls CAN/CAN-FD/LIN/Ethernet traffic between domains; diagnostics (DoIP), OTA staging, security.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg; 8–10 layer when DDR + multi-port Ethernet switch (S32G class)

ecus.name: Airbag / restraint control unit
ecus.function: Crash sensing (internal accelerometers + PSI5 satellites), squib firing, energy reserve, seat-belt pretensioners.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg; energy-reserve electrolytic caps

keyIcs.role: airbag system IC (firing loops, PSI5, energy reserve, safety controller)

ecus.name: Electric power steering controller
ecus.function: 3-phase BLDC/PMSM assist motor control from torque-sensor input; ASIL-D.

pcb.size: control ~80×100 mm; power stage often on IMS or thick-copper/DBC
pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg control + IMS or thick copper (≥3 oz) power stage; 12 V high-current MOSFET bridge (60–120 A)

ecus.name: ABS / ESC brake control unit
ecus.function: Wheel-speed sensing, valve solenoid and pump motor drive for ABS/ESC; mounted on hydraulic unit.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg / ceramic hybrid historically; press-fit to coil carrier

examples: TI DRV3245Q-Q1 (listed for electrical brake and brake assist)

ecus.name: Instrument cluster
ecus.function: Driver display (TFT 7–12.3 in), telltales, chimes.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg; HDI 1+n+1 on SoC-based digital clusters

ecus.name: Infotainment head unit
ecus.function: Media, navigation, smartphone projection, audio amp, centre display.

pcb.technology: HDI (1+n+1 to 3+n+3) FR4 high-Tg; BGA SoC with LPDDR

ecus.name: ADAS radar sensor (front / corner)
ecus.function: 77 GHz FMCW radar for ACC, AEB, blind-spot, cross-traffic.

pcb.technology: Hybrid stack: low-loss RF laminate (PTFE/hydrocarbon) top layer for antennas + FR4 below

examples: NXP TEF82xx (3 Tx / 4 Rx, 76–81 GHz, ASIL B)

ecus.name: ADAS front camera module
ecus.function: Mono/tri camera for lane keeping, AEB, TSR; vision SoC on board.

pcb.technology: HDI FR4 high-Tg; rigid-flex to imager common

examples: Mobileye EyeQ4 Mid/High (ZF S-Cam4 mono and tri-cam)
Mobileye EyeQ5 Mid (7 nm FinFET, 4.6 DL TOPS)

ecus.name: Telematics control unit (TCU)
ecus.function: LTE/5G modem, GNSS, eCall with backup battery, remote services, OTA.

pcb.technology: HDI FR4 high-Tg; RF shielding cans; modem module soldered (LGA)

examples: Qualcomm MDM9250 / Snapdragon X16 LTE (CCARD reference TCU)
MCU/processor + GNSS + LTE modem + Wi-Fi/BLE + Ethernet PHY
Infineon OPTIGA TPM class secure element

ecus.name: Seat control module
ecus.function: Power seat motors, memory, heating/ventilation, occupant sensing.

pcb.technology: FR4; 2 oz copper for motor H-bridges/relays

ecus.name: Door control module
ecus.function: Window lift, mirror, lock motors, switch pack; LIN/CAN node per door.

pcb.technology: FR4; often integrated in window-lift motor housing

examples: TI TIDA-00296 BCM driver design (door locks, window lifts)

ecus.name: HVAC / climate control module
ecus.function: Blower, flap actuators, A/C request; on ICE drives mechanical compressor clutch, on xEV coordinates e-compressor/PTC/heat pump.

pcb.technology: FR4

ecus.name: Headlamp LED driver / matrix controller
ecus.function: LED buck/boost drivers, adaptive driving beam pixel control, levelling.

pcb.size: driver ~60×100 mm; LED boards on IMS
pcb.technology: Driver FR4; LED carriers aluminium IMS

examples: TI front headlight selection guide parts

ecus.name: Engine control module / PCM
ecus.function: Fuel injection, ignition timing, air/boost, knock, lambda, OBD; drives injectors, coils, valves, relays.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg (engine-bay / on-engine mounts); thermal vias under power ICs

placements.range: ~412 components on the main PCB of a Bosch DCU17HD01 ECM teardown (MCU + companion IC, 80 MHz); 400–1,200 typical

keyIcs.role: engine management IC (power outputs, supplies, CAN/LIN)

examples: supplier ASICs; integrated in TLE8888 for 4-cyl

ecus.name: Transmission control unit
ecus.function: Shift scheduling, clutch/solenoid pressure control (AT, DCT, CVT); often mechatronic (in-oil).

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg or LTCC/ceramic for in-oil mechatronics; sealed

examples: Infineon / NXP multi-channel constant-current solenoid drivers

ecus.name: Glow-plug control unit (diesel)
ecus.function: PWM-controlled power to ceramic/metal glow plugs for cold start and after-glow.

pcb.technology: FR4 / thick copper for 4–6 high-current channels

keyIcs.role: smart high-side switches / power MOSFETs per plug

ecus.name: Ignition coil drivers (gasoline)
ecus.function: Coil-on-plug IGBT switching; usually an IGBT in each coil, triggered by the ECM (not a separate ECU on modern cars).

pcb.technology: Leadframe/IGBT in coil body

examples: smart ignition IGBT (e.g. onsemi/Infineon automotive ignition IGBTs)

ecus.name: Fuel-pump controller
ecus.function: Demand-controlled (PWM or BLDC) in-tank low-pressure fuel pump drive.

pcb.technology: FR4; 2 oz copper

examples: automotive 32-bit MCU + 3-phase gate driver (e.g. Infineon MOTIX)

ecus.name: NOx sensor control unit
ecus.function: Heats and reads the zirconia NOx sensor cell, reports NOx/O2 over CAN; one or two per SCR system.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg, potted/sealed housing

ecus.name: Exhaust aftertreatment / SCR dosing control unit
ecus.function: AdBlue/DEF dosing valve, pump and line heater control; often integrated into ECM on passenger cars, separate on heavy duty (e.g. Bosch DCU17).

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg

placements.range: 300–700 (the Bosch DCU17HD01 module torn down had ~412 components on its main PCB)

ecus.name: 12 V intelligent battery sensor
ecus.function: Shunt-based current, voltage and temperature measurement of the 12 V battery; SoC/SoH for energy management and stop-start; on the battery terminal.

pcb.technology: FR4 mounted on manganin shunt / terminal clamp

examples: NXP MM9Z1J638 (LIN and CAN reference designs)

ecus.name: Alternator voltage regulator
ecus.function: Field-current regulation of the 12 V alternator, LIN-controlled 'smart charging'; mounted on alternator.

pcb.technology: Monolithic regulator ASIC on leadframe or small ceramic/FR4 hybrid

ecus.name: 48 V belt starter-generator inverter/controller
ecus.function: Low-voltage high-current inverter for the 10–25 kW BSG: start, boost, regen; often integrated in the machine.

pcb.layers: 4–6 control; power stage on IMS/DBC/thick copper
pcb.size: control ~100×120 mm; power stage annular around machine
pcb.technology: Thick copper (≥4 oz) or IMS / leadframe power module with 80–100 V MOSFETs; FR4 control

examples: Allegro AMT49502 (5.5–80 V, 12 V & 48 V BSG)
TI UCC20225-Q1 (5 drivers: 3 stator + 2 rotor excitation)

keyIcs.role: MCU + gate driver (published 48 V BSG prototype)

ecus.name: 48 V–12 V bidirectional DC-DC converter
ecus.function: Supplies the 12 V net from 48 V (1–3 kW), and the reverse for 48 V pre-charge/start.

pcb.technology: Thick copper (3–4 oz) FR4 or IMS for multiphase buck/boost power stage

ecus.name: 48 V battery management system
ecus.function: 12–14S Li-ion monitoring, balancing, contactor/relay control for the 48 V pack.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg; thick copper if relay/MOSFET disconnect on board

keyIcs.role: cell monitor (14 ch; 48 V pack is 12–14S)

ecus.name: 48 V electric supercharger / e-booster controller
ecus.function: Drives a 48 V high-speed motor-driven compressor for transient boost (fitted on some premium MHEVs, not universal).

pcb.technology: Thick copper / IMS power stage

ecus.name: Hybrid power control unit (motor + generator inverters + boost converter)
ecus.function: Power-split HEV: two inverters (MG1 generator, MG2 motor) and a bidirectional boost converter (e.g. Prius 200 V battery boosted to 650 V).

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg with reinforced isolation (transformer + optocoupler isolation per Prius teardown); separate power cards

keyIcs.role: controller ASIC + 2 MCUs (vector control of motor and generator, resolver, CAN)

examples: 2010 Prius PCU: inverter + boost converter (ORNL evaluation)

ecus.name: Traction inverter (front / rear e-axle)
ecus.function: DC-AC drive of the traction motor (100–300+ kW); IGBT at 400 V, SiC MOSFET dominant at 800 V; PHEV/BEV and some HEV architectures.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg, reinforced isolation creepage (800 V needs ≥ 1200 V class isolation); separate power module + laminated busbar

examples: Infineon AURIX TC3x7 (logic board in Infineon HybridPACK Drive CoolSiC G2 eval kit)
Infineon 1EDI303xAS EiceDRIVER G3 (1EDI3026AS/1EDI3035AS 20 A, inverters >300 kW)

ecus.name: HV battery cell monitoring unit (slave boards)
ecus.function: Per-module cell-voltage / temperature measurement and passive balancing; daisy-chained to the BMU (or wireless).

pcb.size: ~60×150 mm per module board (count = modules: ~4–8 HEV/PHEV, 8–24 BEV)
pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg; isolation slots; may be flex/FPC on CTP packs

ecus.name: HV battery management unit (master) + battery junction box electronics
ecus.function: SoC/SoH, contactor control, pre-charge, isolation monitoring, pack current (shunt/Hall), HVIL; aggregates CMU data.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg; reinforced isolation between HV sense and LV domain

examples: Infineon TLE4972 (named for battery main switch)

ecus.name: HV–12 V DC-DC converter (APM/LDC)
ecus.function: Replaces the alternator: supplies the 12 V net from the HV battery (2–3.6 kW).

pcb.technology: Thick copper (3–6 oz) or busbars for 200–300 A output; planar magnetics common

examples: TI TIDA-020031: 400 V→12 V 3.6 kW phase-shifted full bridge with SiC MOSFETs, 300 A peak
TI PMP41078: GaN PSFB 3.5 kW, 200–450 V in, 14 V out

ecus.name: Vehicle / hybrid control unit (VCU/HCU)
ecus.function: Torque arbitration, energy management, drive mode, charge sequencing; on HEVs the hybrid supervisor.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg

ecus.name: On-board charger
ecus.function: AC charging 3.7–22 kW: PFC (totem-pole) + isolated DC-DC (LLC/CLLC); often combined with HV DC-DC in one box.

pcb.technology: Thick copper (3–4 oz) FR4 power board; IMS or discrete on cold plate

keyIcs.role: SiC MOSFETs + driver (11 kW 3-phase PFC + LLC)

examples: TI C2000 (6.6 kW SiC totem-pole PFC reference)

ecus.name: Charging communication controller (EVCC, CCS PLC)
ecus.function: ISO 15118 / DIN 70121 over HomePlug Green PHY on the CP line for DC fast charging; control pilot/proximity; often merged into OBC or VCU.

pcb.technology: FR4

ecus.name: HV electric A/C compressor inverter
ecus.function: Sensorless FOC drive of the e-compressor motor (3–8 kW), integrated on the compressor; 400 V or 800 V.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg with HV isolation; IPM or discrete IGBT/SiC on cold side

ecus.name: HV PTC heater controller
ecus.function: Switches HV PTC elements (cabin air or coolant, 5–10 kW) in stages/PWM.

pcb.technology: FR4 with HV isolation; IGBTs/MOSFETs on heat sink

examples: TI PTC heater module app note

ecus.name: Thermal management controller / heat-pump controller
ecus.function: Coordinates coolant pumps, valves (octovalve-style manifolds), heat-pump refrigerant EXVs, battery/drive-unit thermal loops.

pcb.technology: FR4 high-Tg
